unavailable_gpus.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
unavailable_gpus.recovery: a cold power cycle: shut down, wait for the rails to drain, power on. nvidia-smi -r is refused on many consumer and workstation cards, and unloading the kernel modules is worse than useless here -- the unload has to talk to the dead GPU to release it, so it blocks for minutes and takes the healthy cards down with it
